questions.question: $B$ at $5\ \mathrm{cm}$ from a long wire carrying $10\ \mathrm{A}$?
Which way does $\mathbf{B}$ circle a current flowing along $+z$?
questions.explain: Right-hand rule: thumb along the current, fingers along $\mathbf{B}$.

questions.question: The magnetic force on a moving charge is
questions.explain: It is perpendicular to the velocity, so it does no work.

questions.question: Why is $\nabla\cdot\mathbf{B}=0$?
questions.explain: Field lines of $\mathbf{B}$ always close on themselves.

questions.question: $B$ inside a long solenoid, $1000$ turns over $50\ \mathrm{cm}$, at $2\ \mathrm{A}$?
Force per unit length between two parallel wires with currents in the same direction is
questions.explain: Like currents attract; opposite currents repel.

questions.question: At a boundary with no surface current, which components are continuous?
questions.explain: $B_{1n}=B_{2n}$ always; $\mathbf{H}_t$ jumps only by a surface current.
